label: sec:step-categorical
html: Categorical step. The substrate parameter q requires a structure to deform. At q = 1, the classical symmetric tensor category appears. For q \neq 1, the action resolves into a braided one. The substrate is a rigid braided monoidal category (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau) equipped with a Frobenius–Hopf object A and a fibre functor \tau. The parameter q records the deformation of this categorical action. The Reeb derivation \delta_q promotes q to a connection on the categorical bundle; its curvature is the Yekutieli MI tower. We develop the axioms and derive the Reeb derivation in subsequent chapters. We develop descent, jets, and the Gröbner–Shirshov filtration to provide the categorical infrastructure.
